content.short: Sigma Prime is a leading provider of Ethereum smart contract security assessments.
content.description: Sigma Prime brings extensive expertise in penetration testing across corporate networks, cloud infrastructure, and web applications, and is a leading provider of Ethereum smart contract security assessments. The firm founded and maintains Lighthouse, an open-source Rust implementation of the Ethereum 2.0 specification, and remains deeply engaged in Ethereum 2.0 engineering and research. Sigma Prime contributes to open-source projects and blockchain research efforts, with findings published in research papers and blog articles. Clients include Chainlink, Dapper, and AlphaWallet.
